§ 314-317 ]          FEMININE BASES.                    187

§ 314. * Prātipadikas expressive of colour, having न for their 
penultimate and ending in an Anudātta vowel, except आसित 
black and पलित grey, and the word पिङ्ग form their feminine in 
ई or आ; एता or एती 'variegated' from एत; रोहिता, रोहिती; पिङ्गी-
पिङ्गा; but आसिता, पलिता, श्वेता ( as the त here is Udātta ).

(a) † But if the Prātipadika has no न for its penultimate, it 
simply takes ई; कल्माषी variegated, सारङ्गी; but कृष्णा कपिला 
( as the last vowels are not Anudātta ).

§ 315. The Feminine of नृ and नर is नारी and that of words 
included in the Shārṅgaravādi ( शार्ङ्गरवादिगण ) group ‡ is formed 
by adding ई; as शार्ङ्गवी, गौतमी, आतिथेयी, आश्रौकेयी, वैद्यी, पुत्री, &c.

§ 316. The feminine of words expressive of relationship is 
irregular; श्वशुर-श्वश्रू, पितृ-मातृ, &c.

§ 317. ¶ The feminine of पति is पत्नी meaning 'the sharer 
with her husband in the fruit of the sacrifices performed by 
him; but if it end a compound it may optionally remain 
unchanged except when preceded by समान, एक, चोर, पिण्ड, ष्व 
धात्र, मह, and पुत्र &c. before which this change is necessary; 
गृहपति or गृहपत्नी, the mistress of the house; or इन्द्रपति or इन्द्रपत्नी; 
उपलपति or उपलपत्नी &c. but समानः पतिर्यस्याः सा सपत्नी a co-wife, 
एकपत्नी, चौरपत्नी.

N. B.—†† If there be no compound this change does not take
